name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008,Lenskart Solutions is a technology-focused eyewear company involved in the design, manufacturing, branding, and retail of prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, and accessories.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1][2] Lenskart is a technology-led, vertically integrated D2C eyewear company. It designs, manufactures, brands and retails prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, contact lenses and accessories through an omnichannel network (stores, app and website) across India and select international markets.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 75.4% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 13.3 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.90% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
